raw: [name="'The Brigadier'"]Your Highness, The Singer has just sent word that The Elocutionist and the rest have taken Loughshinny. They are on their way to County Hillock.
speaker: 'The Brigadier'
content: Your Highness, The Singer has just sent word that The Elocutionist and the rest have taken Loughshinny. They are on their way to County Hillock.

speaker: Eblana
content: I see.

raw: [name="'The Brigadier'"]He only sent news after our troops left and 'The Leader' had already set out for County Hillock. He seemed to want to avoid offending The Elocutionist and his group, but also to avoid accusations of concealing information.
speaker: 'The Brigadier'
content: He only sent news after our troops left and 'The Leader' had already set out for County Hillock. He seemed to want to avoid offending The Elocutionist and his group, but also to avoid accusations of concealing information.

raw: [name="'The Brigadier'"]What should we do with him?
speaker: 'The Brigadier'
content: What should we do with him?

raw: [name="Eblana"]Dublinn has never needed him to be our eyes. No one is counting on him for this.
speaker: Eblana
content: Dublinn has never needed him to be our eyes. No one is counting on him for this.

raw: [name="'The Brigadier'"]My utmost apologies. I take full responsibility. I assumed they were heading towards County Hillock on orders, and never imagined they'd dare to take Loughshinny.
speaker: 'The Brigadier'
content: My utmost apologies. I take full responsibility. I assumed they were heading towards County Hillock on orders, and never imagined they'd dare to take Loughshinny.

raw: [name="'The Brigadier'"]But they haven't gotten far, so we can still catch up if we set off now—
speaker: 'The Brigadier'
content: But they haven't gotten far, so we can still catch up if we set off now—

raw: [name="Harmonie"]Your Highness, I bring news from your sister. She hopes you can curb The Elocutionist and his men from acting rashly, and bring her back.
speaker: Harmonie
content: Your Highness, I bring news from your sister. She hopes you can curb The Elocutionist and his men from acting rashly, and bring her back.

speaker: 'The Brigadier'
content: She said that herself?

speaker: Harmonie
content: That's right.

raw: [name="'The Brigadier'"]I'll mobilize the troops at once—
speaker: 'The Brigadier'
content: I'll mobilize the troops at once—

speaker: Eblana
content: Hold on.

raw: [name="'The Brigadier'"]Your Highness, we should stop them as soon as possible.
speaker: 'The Brigadier'
content: Your Highness, we should stop them as soon as possible.

raw: [name="Harmonie"]Also: 'I don't want to go to County Hillock'. Straight from the dragon's mouth.
speaker: Harmonie
content: Also: 'I don't want to go to County Hillock'. Straight from the dragon's mouth.

raw: [name="Eblana"]If that is truly her desire, then she ought to realize it with her own hands.
speaker: Eblana
content: If that is truly her desire, then she ought to realize it with her own hands.

raw: [name="Eblana"]It would be no difficult task with her flames. Has she not already sentenced quite a few to death in the name of The Leader?
speaker: Eblana
content: It would be no difficult task with her flames. Has she not already sentenced quite a few to death in the name of The Leader?

raw: [name="Eblana"]Tell her this: if that is what she wants, she can do it herself—
speaker: Eblana
content: Tell her this: if that is what she wants, she can do it herself—

raw: [name="Eblana"]No, there's no need for even that.
speaker: Eblana
content: No, there's no need for even that.

raw: [name="Harmonie"]Your Highness, if I may be so bold, she is your—
speaker: Harmonie
content: Your Highness, if I may be so bold, she is your—

speaker: Eblana
content: My sister?

raw: The giant dragon flaps its steel wings, stirring up a flaming vortex, but Loughshinny does not waver.
content: The giant dragon flaps its steel wings, stirring up a flaming vortex, but Loughshinny does not waver.

raw: She stabs her spear firmly in its eye socket.
content: She stabs her spear firmly in its eye socket.

raw: [name="Dragon"]Still unable to commit to killing me, Loughshinny?
speaker: Dragon
content: Still unable to commit to killing me, Loughshinny?

raw: Gradually, the dragon's voice overlaps with Eblana's, and eventually even its body becomes hers.
content: Gradually, the dragon's voice overlaps with Eblana's, and eventually even its body becomes hers.

raw: The scenery around them changes swiftly, just like that night in the ruins with Labhréathach.
content: The scenery around them changes swiftly, just like that night in the ruins with Labhréathach.

speaker: Loughshinny
content: I just... don't know.

speaker: Loughshinny
content: What exactly do you want?

raw: [name="Loughshinny"]You deceived me, and lied to so many, all for what? For the city to be buried alongside you? To become the next legendary King Gaeil?
speaker: Loughshinny
content: You deceived me, and lied to so many, all for what? For the city to be buried alongside you? To become the next legendary King Gaeil?

speaker: Eblana
content: I never lied to you.

raw: [name="Loughshinny"]And why should I believe you now?
speaker: Loughshinny
content: And why should I believe you now?

raw: [name="Loughshinny"]What exactly is Na Saoirsí to you? What about Tara?
speaker: Loughshinny
content: What exactly is Na Saoirsí to you? What about Tara?

raw: [name="Loughshinny"]I had always believed we shared the same dream. So why do they seem completely different now?
speaker: Loughshinny
content: I had always believed we shared the same dream. So why do they seem completely different now?

raw: [name="Loughshinny"]Or will dreams eventually become a card for you to play in your mad pursuit of power? One that you'll inevitably grow bored of, just like...
speaker: Loughshinny
content: Or will dreams eventually become a card for you to play in your mad pursuit of power? One that you'll inevitably grow bored of, just like...

raw: [name="Loughshinny"]Just like Loughshinny back in County Hillock?
speaker: Loughshinny
content: Just like Loughshinny back in County Hillock?

speaker: Eblana
content: County Hillock?

raw: [name="Eblana"]I saw no desire to return to me in your eyes back then, only relief. Was I mistaken?
speaker: Eblana
content: I saw no desire to return to me in your eyes back then, only relief. Was I mistaken?

raw: [name="Eblana"]Though I—indeed. I was truly sick of it back in County Hillock.
speaker: Eblana
content: Though I—indeed. I was truly sick of it back in County Hillock.

raw: [name="Eblana"]With my flames, I can mold anything I want into any shape I want. Everything except my reflection in the mirror.
speaker: Eblana
content: With my flames, I can mold anything I want into any shape I want. Everything except my reflection in the mirror.

raw: [name="Eblana"]No matter how large a blaze I stoked, she wouldn't change one bit.
speaker: Eblana
content: No matter how large a blaze I stoked, she wouldn't change one bit.

speaker: Loughshinny
content: ...Because you've never burned her directly.

speaker: Eblana
content: Because I've never burned you directly.

raw: [name="Eblana"]I've only ever waited. I've always been waiting. Waiting for you to give me an answer.
speaker: Eblana
content: I've only ever waited. I've always been waiting. Waiting for you to give me an answer.

speaker: Loughshinny
content: An answer?

raw: [name="Eblana"]—What about you, Loughshinny? What do you want?
speaker: Eblana
content: —What about you, Loughshinny? What do you want?

raw: [name="Eblana"]Yes, it's good that your blood and your upbringing have you carry yourself high, but if you want for nothing, then what sort of position am I meant to leave by my side for you?
speaker: Eblana
content: Yes, it's good that your blood and your upbringing have you carry yourself high, but if you want for nothing, then what sort of position am I meant to leave by my side for you?

raw: [name="Eblana"]Go on. This is your wish on a snowy night... I'll let you aspire as grand as you want.
speaker: Eblana
content: Go on. This is your wish on a snowy night... I'll let you aspire as grand as you want.

raw: [name="Loughshinny"]True, you never used your flames on me, but only because you had other tools more suited for the task. Fear, duty, guilt, sympathy...
speaker: Loughshinny
content: True, you never used your flames on me, but only because you had other tools more suited for the task. Fear, duty, guilt, sympathy...

raw: [name="Loughshinny"]You've never asked me directly to change, but you've done so indirectly countless times.
speaker: Loughshinny
content: You've never asked me directly to change, but you've done so indirectly countless times.

raw: [name="Eblana"]So all my attempts to guide you were useless, yet my apathy bore fruit? How terribly ironic.
speaker: Eblana
content: So all my attempts to guide you were useless, yet my apathy bore fruit? How terribly ironic.

raw: [name="Eblana"]Whatever the case, you've finally returned of your own will, ready to embrace a real life. That is enough.
speaker: Eblana
content: Whatever the case, you've finally returned of your own will, ready to embrace a real life. That is enough.

raw: [name="Loughshinny"]Conspiracies, lust for power, war... Is that what you'd call a real life?
speaker: Loughshinny
content: Conspiracies, lust for power, war... Is that what you'd call a real life?

raw: [name="Eblana"]Is it not? Stories, poems, legends... Do you think those are enough to constitute a life worthy of you or I?
speaker: Eblana
content: Is it not? Stories, poems, legends... Do you think those are enough to constitute a life worthy of you or I?

raw: [name="Loughshinny"]...I know, I've always been ashamed of myself. Even now I hate myself for not sharing your suffering.
speaker: Loughshinny
content: ...I know, I've always been ashamed of myself. Even now I hate myself for not sharing your suffering.

raw: [name="Loughshinny"]I was the one who left, forcing you to shoulder it all on your own, letting them mold you into who you are now—
speaker: Loughshinny
content: I was the one who left, forcing you to shoulder it all on your own, letting them mold you into who you are now—

speaker: Eblana
content: No, Loughshinny.

raw: [name="Eblana"]Recently, I've been wondering if you're just as arrogant as I am. The only difference is that my arrogance is directed at the land, while yours is focused solely on me.
speaker: Eblana
content: Recently, I've been wondering if you're just as arrogant as I am. The only difference is that my arrogance is directed at the land, while yours is focused solely on me.

speaker: Loughshinny
content: What?

raw: [name="Eblana"]Conspiracies, lust for power, war... Why do you assume those are what shaped me?
speaker: Eblana
content: Conspiracies, lust for power, war... Why do you assume those are what shaped me?

raw: [name="Eblana"]They have never changed me. They simply happened to take on a form I was able to wield with ease, nothing more.
speaker: Eblana
content: They have never changed me. They simply happened to take on a form I was able to wield with ease, nothing more.

raw: [name="Eblana"]The tiniest bit of power can decide whether one lives or dies. Even more power can decide the fate of armies, and an overwhelming amount can decide the rise and fall of nations.
speaker: Eblana
content: The tiniest bit of power can decide whether one lives or dies. Even more power can decide the fate of armies, and an overwhelming amount can decide the rise and fall of nations.

speaker: Eblana
content: But power comes to an end.

raw: [name="Eblana"]The poets have always known this, and I think you do too. Am I wrong, Loughshinny?
speaker: Eblana
content: The poets have always known this, and I think you do too. Am I wrong, Loughshinny?

raw: [name="Eblana"]Death mocks all equally, preparing a predestined end for those who crave power, ruthlessly snatching away everything they spent their whole lives chasing.
speaker: Eblana
content: Death mocks all equally, preparing a predestined end for those who crave power, ruthlessly snatching away everything they spent their whole lives chasing.

raw: [name="Loughshinny"]So if you knew your path would come to naught, why did you still...?
speaker: Loughshinny
content: So if you knew your path would come to naught, why did you still...?

raw: Eblana backs away as the giant steel-forged dragon follows suit.
content: Eblana backs away as the giant steel-forged dragon follows suit.

raw: Is it escaping? Or trying to hide?
content: Is it escaping? Or trying to hide?

raw: Loughshinny subconsciously eases her fire, but in the next moment, bites down on her lip and abruptly increases her strength, pushing Eblana forward.
content: Loughshinny subconsciously eases her fire, but in the next moment, bites down on her lip and abruptly increases her strength, pushing Eblana forward.

raw: [name="Eblana"]Very good. At least you have learned the most fundamental thing required for a life without me.
speaker: Eblana
content: Very good. At least you have learned the most fundamental thing required for a life without me.

speaker: Loughshinny
content: ...Cruelty?

speaker: Eblana
content: Determination.

raw: [name="Eblana"]If you have decided that this path is your life, then step forward and never look back.
speaker: Eblana
content: If you have decided that this path is your life, then step forward and never look back.

raw: [name="Loughshinny"]You should be telling that to the people of Na Saoirsí—
speaker: Loughshinny
content: You should be telling that to the people of Na Saoirsí—

speaker: Eblana
content: Let me finish.

raw: [name="Eblana"]Death mocks all equally... yet I shall mock death.
speaker: Eblana
content: Death mocks all equally... yet I shall mock death.

raw: [name="Eblana"]So bless me, dear sister. For I am finally about to embark on a grand adventure.
speaker: Eblana
content: So bless me, dear sister. For I am finally about to embark on a grand adventure.

raw: Eblana retreats again and again, the smile on her face fainter than ever.
content: Eblana retreats again and again, the smile on her face fainter than ever.

raw: The sensation in Loughshinny's arms of piercing through steel gradually lessens, until it feels as smooth as a stroke through a body, then as hollow as running a spear through flame—
content: The sensation in Loughshinny's arms of piercing through steel gradually lessens, until it feels as smooth as a stroke through a body, then as hollow as running a spear through flame—

raw: Until an immense force like the final flash of a dying light erupts from her speartip, pulling Loughshinny towards the other side.
content: Until an immense force like the final flash of a dying light erupts from her speartip, pulling Loughshinny towards the other side.

raw: Ice-cold flames wrap around her body, and she suddenly realizes that she now stands at the entrance of the citadel, on Red Dragon Square, right in the middle of the fire-returning rite.
content: Ice-cold flames wrap around her body, and she suddenly realizes that she now stands at the entrance of the citadel, on Red Dragon Square, right in the middle of the fire-returning rite.

raw: Or perhaps, the dragon skeleton she is currently entangled with merely returned to its original position, and took the chance to pull her—with her firm grip on her spear—into the core of the funeral flames.
content: Or perhaps, the dragon skeleton she is currently entangled with merely returned to its original position, and took the chance to pull her—with her firm grip on her spear—into the core of the funeral flames.

raw: [name="Eblana"]Do you still wish to get away from me, Loughshinny?
speaker: Eblana
content: Do you still wish to get away from me, Loughshinny?

raw: Light shoots out from Loughshinny's spear, brighter than ever.
content: Light shoots out from Loughshinny's spear, brighter than ever.

raw: In a flash, she feels a burning sensation as painful as her internal organs rupturing repeatedly. The flames of life burst and fade in the center of death, again and again until her weapon can no longer stand her overloaded Arts and bursts aflame as well.
content: In a flash, she feels a burning sensation as painful as her internal organs rupturing repeatedly. The flames of life burst and fade in the center of death, again and again until her weapon can no longer stand her overloaded Arts and bursts aflame as well.

raw: The dragon's bones crash and collide with each other, like thousands of mouths singing their separate elegies.
content: The dragon's bones crash and collide with each other, like thousands of mouths singing their separate elegies.

raw: The flames slowly grow warmer as Eblana's figure gradually fades.
content: The flames slowly grow warmer as Eblana's figure gradually fades.

raw: Loughshinny's lips quiver, itching to say words of farewell. In her heart, she scans every book she has read, yet is unable to recall an appropriate line.
content: Loughshinny's lips quiver, itching to say words of farewell. In her heart, she scans every book she has read, yet is unable to recall an appropriate line.

raw: Before she dissipates, Eblana slowly cradles Loughshinny in an embrace.
content: Before she dissipates, Eblana slowly cradles Loughshinny in an embrace.

raw: [name="Eblana"]Farewell... till death do us meet again.
speaker: Eblana
content: Farewell... till death do us meet again.

raw: [name="Eblana"]I hope you enjoy my parting gift.
speaker: Eblana
content: I hope you enjoy my parting gift.

speaker: Loughshinny
content: Parting... gift?

raw: The mourners in the square are completely oblivious to what is occurring within the flames.
content: The mourners in the square are completely oblivious to what is occurring within the flames.

raw: All they see is a fire growing taller and stronger, now covering the pedestal, the coffin, the dragon sculpture, the citadel, yet continuing to ascend.
content: All they see is a fire growing taller and stronger, now covering the pedestal, the coffin, the dragon sculpture, the citadel, yet continuing to ascend.

raw: The flames distort the dragon's figure. They can no longer tell whether it is flapping its wings in flight, in a death match with some unseen foe, or crying out in anguish with its head run through.
content: The flames distort the dragon's figure. They can no longer tell whether it is flapping its wings in flight, in a death match with some unseen foe, or crying out in anguish with its head run through.

raw: Everyone is silent, trying to identify its posture in the firelight, but all is in vain—
content: Everyone is silent, trying to identify its posture in the firelight, but all is in vain—

raw: Until Brigid cries out in surprise.
content: Until Brigid cries out in surprise.

speaker: Brigid
content: The fire changed color!
The fire changed color.

raw: A strong wind rising up from the ground turns the sky-searing purple flames into a maelstrom, and at the bottom where the coffin lies arises a small but scorching sun.
content: A strong wind rising up from the ground turns the sky-searing purple flames into a maelstrom, and at the bottom where the coffin lies arises a small but scorching sun.

raw: The entire deep purple vortex seems to light up, emitting a shining yellow from the bottom to the top.
content: The entire deep purple vortex seems to light up, emitting a shining yellow from the bottom to the top.

raw: Everyone near the bonfire backs away—the flames suddenly bear warmth, nearly burning them.
content: Everyone near the bonfire backs away—the flames suddenly bear warmth, nearly burning them.

raw: The rising heat dissipates, evaporating even the stream of sorrow.
content: The rising heat dissipates, evaporating even the stream of sorrow.

raw: Perhaps a miracle is about to occur. This is the only thought on anyone's mind.
content: Perhaps a miracle is about to occur. This is the only thought on anyone's mind.

raw: [name="Loughshinny"]A miracle, one I have no choice but to accept for Tara...
speaker: Loughshinny
content: A miracle, one I have no choice but to accept for Tara...

raw: [name="Loughshinny"]Is this the parting gift you prepared for me, Sister?
speaker: Loughshinny
content: Is this the parting gift you prepared for me, Sister?

raw: Eblana is undeniably dead. She cannot answer.
content: Eblana is undeniably dead. She cannot answer.

raw: Loughshinny tries to recall their hug. Expectations met, a pinch of warmth, and cold calculation. What were the proportions of each in that embrace?
content: Loughshinny tries to recall their hug. Expectations met, a pinch of warmth, and cold calculation. What were the proportions of each in that embrace?

raw: Or maybe, all those things were inseparable to Eblana.
content: Or maybe, all those things were inseparable to Eblana.

speaker: Loughshinny
content: You were right, Eblana.

raw: [name="Loughshinny"]If this was your ultimate goal, if you insist on laying this bloodstained crown atop my head, then, yes.
speaker: Loughshinny
content: If this was your ultimate goal, if you insist on laying this bloodstained crown atop my head, then, yes.

speaker: Loughshinny
content: Slán abhaile.

speaker: Loughshinny
content: Until death, we shan't meet again.

raw: The flaming vortex exhales and dissipates.
content: The flaming vortex exhales and dissipates.

raw: The Red Dragon, the one who led the Tarans through the long night, steps forth from the statue's center towards the entirety of Na Saoirsí.
content: The Red Dragon, the one who led the Tarans through the long night, steps forth from the statue's center towards the entirety of Na Saoirsí.

raw: Her expression is blurred by flame, yet her figure is as solid as the ever-persistent life on the land.
content: Her expression is blurred by flame, yet her figure is as solid as the ever-persistent life on the land.
One step, then another.

raw: Her feet step over the coffin still burning in purple embers. There is no body within, only the familiar flame-spewing spear of The Leader.
content: Her feet step over the coffin still burning in purple embers. There is no body within, only the familiar flame-spewing spear of The Leader.

raw: The crowd holds their breath, and the square falls silent, as if they stand outside a hospital's delivery room, or perhaps a cemetery after the last shovel of soil has been heaped into a grave.
content: The crowd holds their breath, and the square falls silent, as if they stand outside a hospital's delivery room, or perhaps a cemetery after the last shovel of soil has been heaped into a grave.

raw: Only dancing flames remain, without rest.
content: Only dancing flames remain, without rest.

raw: [Subtitle(text="I can forgive everything else you've done to me, Eblana, but not this parting gift... Never.", x=300, y=370, alignment="center", size=24, delay=0.04, width=700)]
text: I can forgive everything else you've done to me, Eblana, but not this parting gift... Never.

raw: [Subtitle(text="From past to present, your name will sink into oblivion, alongside the countless names who built Tara.", x=300, y=370, alignment="center", size=24, delay=0.04, width=700)]
text: From past to present, your name will sink into oblivion, alongside the countless names who built Tara.

raw: [Subtitle(text="The only Red Dragon of Tara will be Loughshinny Dublinn.", x=300, y=370, alignment="center", size=24, delay=0.04, width=700)]
text: The only Red Dragon of Tara will be Loughshinny Dublinn.

speaker: Loughshinny
content: I have returned.

raw: [name="Loughshinny"]The Red Dragon who led you in the fight against Victoria, in the fight for independence and freedom—
speaker: Loughshinny
content: The Red Dragon who led you in the fight against Victoria, in the fight for independence and freedom—

raw: [name="Loughshinny"]Loughshinny Dublinn... is back from the abyss of death.
speaker: Loughshinny
content: Loughshinny Dublinn... is back from the abyss of death.

raw: [name="Loughshinny"]I died to quench the flames upon you all, but the rain of tears you shed for me extinguished that fire, allowing me to return from the abyss.
speaker: Loughshinny
content: I died to quench the flames upon you all, but the rain of tears you shed for me extinguished that fire, allowing me to return from the abyss.

raw: [name="Loughshinny"]This time, though, I will not drive you to your deaths.
speaker: Loughshinny
content: This time, though, I will not drive you to your deaths.

raw: [name="Loughshinny"]Our grand undertaking is complete. Never again will there be cause for countless Tarans to offer up their lives and leave us only ruins and wailing.
speaker: Loughshinny
content: Our grand undertaking is complete. Never again will there be cause for countless Tarans to offer up their lives and leave us only ruins and wailing.

raw: [name="Loughshinny"]I pray with all my heart that every Taran will be able to curb their own flame—flames that came from slavery, from oppression, from humiliation, from sorrow that never died out, not for thousands of years.
speaker: Loughshinny
content: I pray with all my heart that every Taran will be able to curb their own flame—flames that came from slavery, from oppression, from humiliation, from sorrow that never died out, not for thousands of years.

raw: [name="Loughshinny"]I neither need nor expect you to forget. I only hope that you can do as our ancestors did, and let those flames become your lamp.
speaker: Loughshinny
content: I neither need nor expect you to forget. I only hope that you can do as our ancestors did, and let those flames become your lamp.

raw: [name="Loughshinny"]A lamp that first warms yourself, and then...
speaker: Loughshinny
content: A lamp that first warms yourself, and then...

raw: [name="Loughshinny"]...illuminates the path for us all. So we can truly laugh, sing, and live in our homeland.
speaker: Loughshinny
content: ...illuminates the path for us all. So we can truly laugh, sing, and live in our homeland.

speaker: Loughshinny
content: A bright yet gentle light.

raw: While the crowd is still mulling over her words, one of the residents suddenly cries out in pain.
content: While the crowd is still mulling over her words, one of the residents suddenly cries out in pain.

raw: [name="Sensitive Resident"]Agh! Why is the burn on my hand suddenly hurting?
speaker: Sensitive Resident
content: Agh! Why is the burn on my hand suddenly hurting?

raw: [name="Sensitive Resident"]Wait, the colors of all your lamps...
speaker: Sensitive Resident
content: Wait, the colors of all your lamps...

speaker: Sensitive Resident
content: Even my own changed colors!

raw: [name="Nemos"]These are the lights the Red Dragon hopes you will carry to warm yourselves.
speaker: Nemos
content: These are the lights the Red Dragon hopes you will carry to warm yourselves.

raw: [name="Nemos"]Purple fire belongs only to the dead, yet we unwittingly let our own flames be dyed its color through overwhelming death and loss.
speaker: Nemos
content: Purple fire belongs only to the dead, yet we unwittingly let our own flames be dyed its color through overwhelming death and loss.

raw: [name="Nemos"]But we mistook that fire for a blessing, and allowed ourselves to be dragged towards the abyss...
speaker: Nemos
content: But we mistook that fire for a blessing, and allowed ourselves to be dragged towards the abyss...

raw: [name="Nemos"]If the Red Dragon hadn't killed herself tonight, and we hadn't managed to return her flames, we could all have been dead by now, turned into walking corpses.
speaker: Nemos
content: If the Red Dragon hadn't killed herself tonight, and we hadn't managed to return her flames, we could all have been dead by now, turned into walking corpses.

raw: [name="Sensitive Resident"]To extinguish the flames of death in ourselves... You said that's why she killed herself?
speaker: Sensitive Resident
content: To extinguish the flames of death in ourselves... You said that's why she killed herself?

raw: The sense of guilt that had crept up on Nemos after the purple flames vanished leaves her unable to reply. She only nods slightly.
content: The sense of guilt that had crept up on Nemos after the purple flames vanished leaves her unable to reply. She only nods slightly.

raw: Then, she feels a sudden chill on her face.
content: Then, she feels a sudden chill on her face.

raw: It was a drop of water. Nemos lifts her head and looks to the distant night sky.
content: It was a drop of water. Nemos lifts her head and looks to the distant night sky.

raw: More look up as the damp raindrops pelt their faces, gently washing their tears away.
content: More look up as the damp raindrops pelt their faces, gently washing their tears away.
It is raining.

raw: On Samhain's eve the rain falls, heavier and heavier, but the crowd still remains in the square. They wish to thank the Red Dragon for returning their lives, for separating life from death.
content: On Samhain's eve the rain falls, heavier and heavier, but the crowd still remains in the square. They wish to thank the Red Dragon for returning their lives, for separating life from death.

raw: But the dragon tells everyone she will remain here until everyone returns home to rest.
content: But the dragon tells everyone she will remain here until everyone returns home to rest.

raw: So the people gradually disperse, and eventually even the wakemen and refugees bid goodbye to the dragon. They worry that some of the dead, who have not returned their fire yet, will gather around the ruins, although that worry is unfounded.
content: So the people gradually disperse, and eventually even the wakemen and refugees bid goodbye to the dragon. They worry that some of the dead, who have not returned their fire yet, will gather around the ruins, although that worry is unfounded.

raw: By the time the sun rises, no longer will there be any wandering dead on Taran soil.
content: By the time the sun rises, no longer will there be any wandering dead on Taran soil.

raw: Amidst sobs, Nemos bids goodbye to the dragon as well. The next day, she will wake up early to collect bricks from all over town to make a new door for Culann's workshop.
content: Amidst sobs, Nemos bids goodbye to the dragon as well. The next day, she will wake up early to collect bricks from all over town to make a new door for Culann's workshop.

raw: The huge square empties out, leaving only a red dragon and a nomad.
content: The huge square empties out, leaving only a red dragon and a nomad.

raw: [name="Loughshinny"]Where are you off to next, Brigid?
speaker: Loughshinny
content: Where are you off to next, Brigid?

raw: [name="Brigid"]...Not sure there's anywhere to go, really. All I've ever done is pass on messages or report oncoming Catastrophes.
speaker: Brigid
content: ...Not sure there's anywhere to go, really. All I've ever done is pass on messages or report oncoming Catastrophes.

raw: [name="Brigid"]I think they will replace my job though... What are they called again? 'Catastrophe Messengers'?
speaker: Brigid
content: I think they will replace my job though... What are they called again? 'Catastrophe Messengers'?

raw: [name="Brigid"]There've been less and less of us nomads anyhow, so I guess I'm glad someone'll carry on the work, at least.
speaker: Brigid
content: There've been less and less of us nomads anyhow, so I guess I'm glad someone'll carry on the work, at least.

speaker: Loughshinny
content: You should try contacting Rhodes Island.

speaker: Brigid
content: Hm? What's that?

raw: [name="Loughshinny"]A pharmaceutical company. They're good people. You'll have to look for their headquarters—it's a landship.
speaker: Loughshinny
content: A pharmaceutical company. They're good people. You'll have to look for their headquarters—it's a landship.

raw: [name="Loughshinny"]I'll write them a letter tomorrow, and I was hoping you could deliver it for me. I think you'll like the place.
speaker: Loughshinny
content: I'll write them a letter tomorrow, and I was hoping you could deliver it for me. I think you'll like the place.

raw: [name="Loughshinny"]But for tonight... You ought to rest inside the fort. We can't have you sleeping in a tent with all this rain.
speaker: Loughshinny
content: But for tonight... You ought to rest inside the fort. We can't have you sleeping in a tent with all this rain.

raw: [name="Loughshinny"]Let's head to the citadel gates first.
speaker: Loughshinny
content: Let's head to the citadel gates first.

raw: The two of them slowly make their way towards the citadel.
content: The two of them slowly make their way towards the citadel.

raw: The downpour continues, and the fire on the sculpture is nearly extinguished. Only a faint flame of indistinct color flickers in the dragon's eye sockets.
content: The downpour continues, and the fire on the sculpture is nearly extinguished. Only a faint flame of indistinct color flickers in the dragon's eye sockets.

raw: They suddenly hear a voice from behind.
content: They suddenly hear a voice from behind.

raw: [name="???"]Stubbornness and stupidity really are hereditary, I'm telling you.
content: Stubbornness and stupidity really are hereditary, I'm telling you.

raw: [name="???"]How can someone forget their own bet?
content: How can someone forget their own bet?

raw: [name="Loughshinny"]Is there someone still in the square?
speaker: Loughshinny
content: Is there someone still in the square?

raw: [name="Brigid"]It's that invisible brother of mine. He made a bet with me.
speaker: Brigid
content: It's that invisible brother of mine. He made a bet with me.

speaker: Loughshinny
content: Invisible?

speaker: Brigid
content: Don't turn around, Loughshinny.

raw: [name="Brigid"]He's a wee bit awkward, that one. No fan of being seen, I'm sure.
speaker: Brigid
content: He's a wee bit awkward, that one. No fan of being seen, I'm sure.

speaker: The Exiled King
content: Hah.

raw: Looking at the flickering flame in the dragon's eyes, Labhréathach recalls a time centuries past. When Ailill was still a lad with a cracking voice, while his own beard had just started to sprout.
content: Looking at the flickering flame in the dragon's eyes, Labhréathach recalls a time centuries past. When Ailill was still a lad with a cracking voice, while his own beard had just started to sprout.

raw: Máighréad, 'the Exquisite', was promoting everything Victorian in the royal capital, and ultimately even banned a favorite custom for Taran commoners: placing bets.
content: Máighréad, 'the Exquisite', was promoting everything Victorian in the royal capital, and ultimately even banned a favorite custom for Taran commoners: placing bets.

raw: That day, Labhréathach had exploded in an argument with his mother, with an unprecedented level of rage.
content: That day, Labhréathach had exploded in an argument with his mother, with an unprecedented level of rage.

raw: Afterwards, his mother ordered him to fast and reflect, but Ailill sneaked into his brother's bedroom with a big piece of steak for him.
content: Afterwards, his mother ordered him to fast and reflect, but Ailill sneaked into his brother's bedroom with a big piece of steak for him.

raw: The brothers blew out every light in the room and merrily gorged themselves, even licking their fingers clean. 'Enough stubbornness. Soon everyone in the capital will be a Victorian.' Ailill said.
content: The brothers blew out every light in the room and merrily gorged themselves, even licking their fingers clean. 'Enough stubbornness. Soon everyone in the capital will be a Victorian.' Ailill said.

raw: Labhréathach stroked his still-soft beard, and merely shook his head. He asked: Then why not make a bet with me? Once Mother's gone, not a soul will willingly continue pretending they're Victorian.
content: Labhréathach stroked his still-soft beard, and merely shook his head. He asked: Then why not make a bet with me? Once Mother's gone, not a soul will willingly continue pretending they're Victorian.
'Fine.' Ailill replied.

raw: The older brother burst into laughter. 'What's on the table, then? What'd make a good wager? Why not the crown? If you win, I'll never set foot in the palace for the rest of my life.'
content: The older brother burst into laughter. 'What's on the table, then? What'd make a good wager? Why not the crown? If you win, I'll never set foot in the palace for the rest of my life.'
'No. I'll wager anything but that.'

raw: Ailill had refused. It was I who insisted on having it my way, half as a joke, and half hungry for a gamble. I nearly put him in tears, didn't I?
content: Ailill had refused. It was I who insisted on having it my way, half as a joke, and half hungry for a gamble. I nearly put him in tears, didn't I?

raw: Yes, yes. Because Ailill was always the type to give in. He'd definitely agree.
content: Yes, yes. Because Ailill was always the type to give in. He'd definitely agree.

raw: And so, in the end, he said: 'Alright. If you go, then never come back.'
content: And so, in the end, he said: 'Alright. If you go, then never come back.'

raw: Afterwards, I ended up leaving the palace, wandering for years as Ailill spent that time unhappy in the capital.
content: Afterwards, I ended up leaving the palace, wandering for years as Ailill spent that time unhappy in the capital.

raw: I heard that after losing half his men in the court, Ailill was controlled by not even Victorians, but Taran nobles speaking with Victorian accents.
content: I heard that after losing half his men in the court, Ailill was controlled by not even Victorians, but Taran nobles speaking with Victorian accents.

speaker: The Exiled King
content: You lost, Labhréathach.

raw: [name="The Exiled King"]No matter how homesick you are, you've spent far too long on this family visit.
speaker: The Exiled King
content: No matter how homesick you are, you've spent far too long on this family visit.

raw: [name="The Exiled King"]Not to mention you're just a pathetic shadow cast by firelight. Man, you have your own road to walk. No more breaking promises.
speaker: The Exiled King
content: Not to mention you're just a pathetic shadow cast by firelight. Man, you have your own road to walk. No more breaking promises.

raw: [name="The Exiled King"]Right, just like that, take out that purple fire from the stab wound on your chest—
speaker: The Exiled King
content: Right, just like that, take out that purple fire from the stab wound on your chest—

speaker: The Exiled King
content: Ugh, argh...

raw: [name="The Exiled King"]Agh—And now, return it to the dragon who walked the same path you did...
speaker: The Exiled King
content: Agh—And now, return it to the dragon who walked the same path you did...

raw: The Exiled King's face twists from pain, but nevertheless he extends his arm bit by bit towards the eye of the skeleton.
content: The Exiled King's face twists from pain, but nevertheless he extends his arm bit by bit towards the eye of the skeleton.

speaker: The Exiled King
content: *cough* *cough*, argh...

raw: [name="The Exiled King"]Let's see, Ailill. Is this your blade's...
speaker: The Exiled King
content: Let's see, Ailill. Is this your blade's...

raw: Can phantoms also feel pain? Can they shed tears of anguish? Or is it merely the rain dripping through him as his body fades to nothingness?
content: Can phantoms also feel pain? Can they shed tears of anguish? Or is it merely the rain dripping through him as his body fades to nothingness?
He can no longer tell.

raw: [name="The Exiled King"]...Or perhaps the flame of your good descendant here—
speaker: The Exiled King
content: ...Or perhaps the flame of your good descendant here—

speaker: Loughshinny
content: Labhréathach!

raw: Loughshinny snaps around, but there is no sign of anyone else in the square.
content: Loughshinny snaps around, but there is no sign of anyone else in the square.

raw: Only the purple fire in the red dragon's eyes. It flares up a split second, before the rain extinguishes it completely.
content: Only the purple fire in the red dragon's eyes. It flares up a split second, before the rain extinguishes it completely.
